All known isotopes of bohrium are extremely radioaktibo; the most stable known isotope is Bh-270 with a half-life of approximately 61 seconds, though the unconfirmed Bh-278 may have a longer half-life of about 690 seconds.

title: boron
text: Boron ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong B and bilang atomiko 5. Produced entirely by cosmic ray spallation and supernovae and not by stellar nucleosynthesis, it ay isang low-abundance element in the Solar System and in the Earth's crust. It constitutes about 0.001 percent by weight of Earth’s crust. Boron is concentrated on Earth by the water-solubility of its more common likas nagaganap compounds, the borate minerals. These are mined industrially as evaporites, such as borax and kernite. The largest known boron deposits are in Turkey, the largest producer of boron minerals.

title: bromine
text: Bromine ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Br and bilang atomiko 35. It is the third-lightest halohen, and ay isang fuming red-brown likido at room temperature that evaporates readily to form a similarly coloured gas. Its properties are thus intermediate between those of chlorine and iodine. Isolated independently by two chemists, Carl Jacob Löwig (in 1825) and Antoine Jérôme Balard (in 1826), its name was derived from the Ancient Greek βρῶμος ("stench"), referencing its sharp and disagreeable smell.

title: cadmium
text: Ang cadmium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Cd at atomic number na 48. Ito ay isang malambot, pilak-puting metal na kemikal na katulad ng zinc. Ang cadmium ay natuklasan nang independiyente ng dalawang chemist, sina Friedrich Stromeyer at Karl Samuel Leberecht Hermann, kapwa noong 1817. Ang elemento at ang mga compound nito ay lubhang nakakalason. Ang cadmium ay ginagamit sa nickel-cadmium batteries, bilang anti-corrosion coating, at bilang stabilizer sa plastics. Dahil sa kanyang toxicity, ang paggamit ng cadmium ay limitado na sa maraming aplikasyon.

title: caesium
text: Caesium (IUPAC spelling) (also spelled cesium in American English) ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Cs and bilang atomiko 55. It ay isang soft, pilak-golden alkali metal with a melting point of 28.5 °C (83.3 °F), which makes it one of only five elemental metals that are likido at or near room temperature. Caesium has physical and chemical properties similar to those of rubidium and potassium. The most reactive of all metals, it is pyrophoric and reacts with water even at −116 °C (−177 °F). It is the least electronegative element, with a value of 0.79 on the Pauling scale. It has only one stable isotope, caesium-133. Caesium is mined mostly from pollucite, while the radioisotopes, especially caesium-137, a fission product, are extracted from waste produced by nuclear reactors.

title: calcium
text: Calcium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Ca and bilang atomiko 20. As an alkaline earth metal, calcium ay isang reactive metal that forms a dark oxide-nitride layer when exposed to air. Its physical and chemical properties are most similar to its heavier homologues strontium and barium. It is the fifth most abundant element in Earth's crust and the third most abundant metal, after iron and aluminium. The most common calcium compound on Earth is calcium carbonate, found in limestone and the fossilised remnants of early sea life; gypsum, anhydrite, fluorite, and apatite are also sources of calcium. The name derives from Latin calx "lime", which was obtained from heating limestone.

title: californium
text: Ang californium ay isang radioactive na elementong kemikal na may simbolong Cf at atomic number na 98. Ito ay isang actinide na unang na-synthesize sa University of California, Berkeley noong 1950. Ang elemento ay pinangalanan mula sa estado ng California at sa unibersidad. Ang californium-252 ay isang malakas na neutron source at ginagamit sa pagbabarena para sa langis at tubig, pati na rin upang simulan ang mga nuclear reactor. Ito ay isa sa mga pinaka-toxic na sangkap na umiiral at dapat hawakan nang may lubhang pag-iingat.

title: carbon
text: Carbon (from Latin: carbo "coal") ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong C and bilang atomiko 6. It is nonmetallic and tetravalent—making four electrons available to form covalent chemical bonds. It belongs to grupo 14 of the periodic table. Carbon makes up only about 0.025 percent of Earth’s crust. Three isotopes occur likas, C-12 and C-13 being stable, while C-14 ay isang radionuclide, decaying with a half-life of about 5,730 years. Carbon is one of the few elements known since antiquity.

title: cerium
text: Cerium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Ce and bilang atomiko 58. Cerium ay isang soft, ductile and pilak-puti metal that tarnishes when exposed to air, and it is soft enough to be cut with a knife. Cerium is the second element in the lanthanide serye, and while it often shows the +3 oxidation state characteristic of the serye, it also has a stable +4 state that does not oxidize water. It ay isanglso considered one of the bihira-earth elements. Cerium has no biological role in humans and is not very toxic.

title: chlorine
text: Ang chlorine ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Cl at atomic number na 17. Ito ay isang dilaw-berdeng gas sa temperatura ng kuwarto at ito ang pangalawang pinakamabigat sa mga halogen. Ang chlorine ay natuklasan noong 1774 ng Swedish chemist na si Carl Wilhelm Scheele. Ito ay napakareactive at bumubuo ng mga compound sa halos lahat ng iba pang elemento. Ang chlorine ay pangunahing ginagamit para sa water purification, pam papaputi, at sa produksyon ng plastics at iba pang kemikal. Ang chlorine ay mahalaga sa mga biological system kung saan ito ay nangyayari bilang chloride ion.

title: chromium
text: Ang chromium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Cr at atomic number na 24. Ito ay isang matigas, pilak na metal na may mataas na melting point. Ang chromium ay natuklasan noong 1797 ng French chemist na si Louis Nicolas Vauquelin. Ang pangalan ay nanggaling sa Greek na salita para sa kulay dahil maraming chromium compound ay may malakas na kulay. Ang chromium ay pangunahing ginagamit upang gumawa ng stainless steel at iba pang alloy, pati na rin para sa electroplating at bilang pigment sa mga pintura. Ito ay isang essential trace element para sa mga tao at hayop.

title: cobalt
text: Cobalt ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Co and bilang atomiko 27. Like nickel, cobalt is found in the Earth's crust only in chemically combined form, save for small deposits found in alloys of natural meteoric iron. The free element, produced by reductive smelting, ay isang hard, lustrous, silver-abo metal.

title: copernicium
text: Copernicium ay isang sintetiko elementong kemikal na may simbolong Cn and bilang atomiko 112. Its known isotopes are extremely radioaktibo, and have only been created in a laboratory. The most stable known isotope, copernicium-285, has a half-life of approximately 28 seconds. Copernicium was first created in 1996 by the GSI Helmholtz Centre for Heavy Ion Research near Darmstadt, Germany. It is named after the astronomer Nicolaus Copernicus.

title: copper
text: Copper ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Cu (from Latin: cuprum) and bilang atomiko 29. It ay isang soft, malleable, and ductile metal with very high thermal and electrical conductivity. A freshly exposed surface of pure copper has a pinkish-orange color. Copper is used as a conductor of heat and electricity, as a building material, and as a constituent of various metal alloys, such as sterling silver used in jewelry, cupronickel used to make marine hardware and coins, and constantan used in strain gauges and thermocouples for temperature measurement.

title: curium
text: Curium ay isang transuranic radioaktibo elementong kemikal na may simbolong Cm and bilang atomiko 96. This element of the actinide serye was named after Marie and Pierre Curie – both were known for their research on radioactivity. Curium was first intentionally produced and identified in July 1944 by the grupo of Glenn T. Seaborg at the University of California, Berkeley. The discovery was kept secret and only released to the public in November 1947. Most curium is produced by bombarding uranium or plutonium with neutrons in nuclear reactors – one tonne of spent nuclear fuel contains about 20 grams of curium.

title: darmstadtium
text: Darmstadtium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Ds and bilang atomiko 110. It ay isangn extremely radioaktibo sintetiko element. The most stable known isotope, darmstadtium-281, has a half-life of approximately 12.7 seconds. Darmstadtium was first created in 1994 by the GSI Helmholtz Centre for Heavy Ion Research near the city of Darmstadt, Germany, after which it was named.

title: dubnium
text: Dubnium ay isang sintetiko elementong kemikal na may simbolong Db and bilang atomiko 105. Dubnium is highly radioaktibo: the most stable known isotope, dubnium-268, has a half-life of about 28 hours. This greatly limits the extent of research on dubnium.

title: dysprosium
text: Dysprosium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Dy and bilang atomiko 66. It ay isang bihira-earth element with a metallic silver luster. Dysprosium is never found in nature as a free element, though it is found in various minerals, such as xenotime. Naturally nagaganap dysprosium is composed of seven isotopes, the most abundant of which is Dy-164.

title: einsteinium
text:
Einsteinium ay isang sintetiko element na may simbolong Es and bilang atomiko 99. As a member of the actinide serye, it is the seventh transuranic element.

Einsteinium was discovered as a component of the debris of the first hydrogen bomb explosion in 1952, and named after Albert Einstein. Its most common isotope einsteinium-253 (half-life 20.47 days) is produced artificially from decay of californium-253 in a few dedicated high-power nuclear reactors with a total yield on the order of one milligram per year. The reactor synthesis is followed by a complex process of separating einsteinium-253 from other actinides and products of their decay. Other isotopes are synthesized in various laboratories, but in much smaller amounts, by bombarding heavy actinide elements with light ions. Owing to the small amounts of produced einsteinium and the short half-life of its most easily produced isotope, there are currently almost no practical applications for it outside basic scientific research. In particular, einsteinium was used to synthesize, for the first time, 17 atoms of the new element mendelevium in 1955.

title: erbium
text: Erbium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Er and bilang atomiko 68. A pilak-puti solido metal when artificially isolated, natural erbium ay isanglways found in chemical combination with other elements. It ay isang lanthanide, a bihira earth element, originally found in the gadolinite mine in Ytterby in Sweden, from which it got its name.

title: europium
text: Europium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Eu and bilang atomiko 63. Europium is the most reactive lanthanide by far, having to be stored under an inert fluid to protect it from atmospheric oxygen or moisture. Europium ay isanglso the softest lanthanide, as it can be dented with a fingernail and easily cut with a knife. When oxidation is removed a shiny-puti metal is visible. Europium was isolated in 1901 and is named after the continent of Europe. Being a typical member of the lanthanide serye, europium usually assumes the oxidation state +3, but the oxidation state +2 ay isanglso common. All europium compounds with oxidation state +2 are slightly reducing. Europium has no significant biological role and is relatively non-toxic compared to other heavy metals. Most applications of europium exploit the phosphorescence of europium compounds. Europium is one of the bihirast of the bihira earth elements on Earth.

title: fermium
text: Fermium ay isang sintetiko element na may simbolong Fm and bilang atomiko 100. It ay isangn actinide and the heaviest element that can be formed by neutron bombardment of lighter elements, and hence the last element that can be prepared in macroscopic quantities, although pure fermium metal has not yet been prepared. A total of 19 isotopes are known, with Fm-257 being the longest-lived with a half-life of 100.5 days.

title: flerovium
text: Ang flerovium ay isang sintetikong elementong kemikal na may simbolong Fl at atomic number na 114. Ito ay isang lubhang radioactive transuranic metal. Ang elemento ay unang na-synthesize noong 1998 sa Joint Institute for Nuclear Research ng Russia. Ito ay pinangalanan mula sa Russian physicist na si Georgii Flerov. Dahil sa maikling half-life nito at sa kahirapan ng paggawa nito, napakaliit lamang ng pananaliksik ang naisakatuparan sa mga chemical properties ng flerovium. Ito ay isa sa mga pinakamabigat na elemento na ginawa.

title: fluorine
text: Fluorine ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong F and bilang atomiko 9. It is the lightest halohen and exists as a highly toxic pale yellow diatomic gas at standard conditions. As the most electronegative element, it is extremely reactive, as it reacts with all other elements, except for argon, neon, and helium.

title: francium
text: Ang francium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Fr at atomic number na 87. Ito ay isang lubhang radioactive alkali metal na natuklasan noong 1939 ng French chemist na si Marguerite Perey sa Radium Institute sa Paris. Ito ay pinangalanan mula sa France. Ang francium ay isa sa pinaka-unstable sa natural na nangyayaring mga elemento. Dahil sa kanyang extreme rarity at radioactivity, napakaliit lamang ng pananaliksik ang naisakatuparan sa mga chemical properties ng francium. Tinatantya na mayroon lamang humigit-kumulang 30 grams ng francium sa buong earth's crust sa anumang naibigay na oras.

title: gadolinium
text: Gadolinium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Gd and bilang atomiko 64. Gadolinium ay isang pilak-puti metal when oxidation is removed. It is only slightly malleable and ay isang ductile bihira-earth element. Gadolinium reacts with atmospheric oxygen or moisture slowly to form a black coating. Gadolinium below its Curie point of 20 °C (68 °F) is ferromagnetic, with an attraction to a magnetic field higher than that of nickel. Above this temperature it is the most paramagnetic element. It is found in nature only in an oxidized form. When separated, it usually has impurities of the other bihira-earths because of their similar chemical properties.

title: gallium
text: Gallium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Ga and bilang atomiko 31. Elemental gallium ay isang soft, pilak metal at standard temperature and pressure; however in its likido state it becomes pilak puti. If too much force ay isangpplied, the gallium may fracture conchoidally. It is in grupo 13 of the periodic table, and thus has similarities to the other metals of the grupo, aluminium, indium, and thallium. Gallium does not occur as a free element in nature, but as gallium(III) compounds in trace amounts in zinc ores and in bauxite. Elemental gallium ay isang likido at temperatures greater than 29.76 °C (85.57 °F), and will melt in a person's hands at normal human body temperature of 37 °C (99 °F).

title: germanium
text: Germanium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Ge and bilang atomiko 32. It ay isang lustrous, hard-brittle, aboish-puti metaloid in the carbon grupo, chemically similar to its grupo neighbours silicon and tin. Pure germanium ay isang semiconductor with an anyo similar to elemental silicon. Like silicon, germanium likas reacts and forms complexes with oxygen in nature.

title: gold
text: Gold ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Au (from Latin: aurum) and bilang atomiko 79, making it one of the higher bilang atomiko elements that occur likas. In a pure form, it ay isang bright, slightly reddish yellow, dense, soft, malleable, and ductile metal. Chemically, gold ay isang transition metal and a grupo 11 element. It is one of the least reactive elementong kemikals and is solido under standard conditions. Gold often occurs in free elemental (native) form, as nuggets or grains, in rocks, in veins, and in alluvial deposits. It occurs in a solido solution serye with the native element silver (as electrum) and also likas alloyed with copper and palladium. Less commonly, it occurs in minerals as gold compounds, often with tellurium (gold tellurides).

title: hafnium
text: Hafnium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Hf and bilang atomiko 72. A lustrous, pilak abo, tetravalent transition metal, hafnium chemically resembles zirconium and is found in many zirconium minerals. Its existence was predicted by Dmitri Mendeleev in 1869, though it was not identified until 1923, by Coster and Hevesy, making it the last stable element to be discovered. Hafnium is named after Hafnia, the Latin name for Copenhagen, where it was discovered.

title: hassium
text: Ang hassium ay isang sintetikong elementong kemikal na may simbolong Hs at atomic number na 108. Ito ay kabilang sa mga transition metal at unang na-synthesize noong 1984 sa Gesellschaft für Schwerionenforschung sa Darmstadt, Germany. Ang elemento ay pinangalanan mula sa Latin na anyo ng pangalan ng German state ng Hesse. Dahil sa sobrang maikling half-life nito, napakaliit lamang ng pananaliksik ang naisakatuparan sa mga properties ng hassium. Inaasahang ito ay solid metal sa room temperature kung sapat na magagawa.

title: helium
text: Ang helium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong He at atomic number na 2. Ito ay isang walang kulay, walang amoy, walang lasa, non-toxic at inert noble gas. Ang helium ay unang natuklasan sa solar spectrum noong 1868 ng French astronomer na si Jules Janssen sa panahon ng solar eclipse. Ang pangalan ay nanggaling sa Greek na salita para sa araw, helios. Ang helium ay ang pangalawang pinaka-karaniwang elemento sa uniberso pagkatapos ng hydrogen. Ito ay ginagamit sa cryogenics, bilang shielding gas sa welding, upang puno ang mga lobo at dirigible, at sa deep-sea diving.

title: holmium
text:
Ang Holmium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Ho at atomic number 67. Bahagi ng serye ng lanthanide, ang holmium ay isang rare-earth element.

Natuklasan ang Holmium sa pamamagitan ng paghihiwalay ni Swedish chemist na si Per Theodor Cleve at malayang ginawa rin nina Jacques-Louis Soret at Marc Delafontaine na nag-obserba nito sa pamamagitan ng spectroscopy noong 1878. Ang oxide nito ay unang inihiwalay mula sa rare-earth ores ni Cleve noong 1878. Ang pangalan ng elemento ay nagmula sa Holmia, ang Latin na pangalan para sa lungsod ng Stockholm.

title: hydrogen
text: Ang hydrogen ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong H at atomic number na 1. Ito ay ang pinakagaan at pinaka-karaniwang elemento sa uniberso. Ang hydrogen ay unang na-identify bilang hiwalay na elemento noong 1766 ng English chemist na si Henry Cavendish. Ang pangalan ay nanggaling sa Greek na mga salita para sa tubig-anyo. Ang hydrogen ay walang kulay, walang amoy, at lubhang masusunog. Ito ay makikita sa tubig at sa lahat ng organic compound. Ang hydrogen ay ginamit bilang rocket fuel, sa produksyon ng ammonia, at bilang potensyal na malinis na mapagkukunan ng enerhiya.

title: indium
text: Indium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong In and bilang atomiko 49. Indium is the softest metal that is not an alkali metal. It ay isang pilak-puti metal that resembles tin in anyo. It ay isang post-transition metal that makes up 0.21 parts per million of the Earth's crust. Indium has a melting point higher than sodium and gallium, but lower than lithium and tin. Chemically, indium is similar to gallium and thallium, and it is largely intermediate between the two in terms of its properties. Indium was discovered in 1863 by Ferdinand Reich and Hieronymous Theodor Richter by spectroscopic methods. They named it for the indigo blue line in its spectrum. Indium was isolated the next year.

title: iodine
text: Ang iodine ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong I at atomic number na 53. Ito ay isang makintab na itim-abong solid halogen na bumubuo ng violet gas kapag pinainit. Ang iodine ay natuklasan noong 1811 ng French chemist na si Bernard Courtois. Ang pangalan ay nanggaling sa Greek na salita para sa violet. Ang iodine ay essential para sa thyroid function sa mga mammal. Ang kakulangan ng iodine ay humahantong sa goiter at iba pang mga problema sa kalusugan. Ang iodine ay ginagamit sa medisina bilang antiseptic at sa iodized salt upang maiwasan ang iodine deficiency.

title: iridium
text: Iridium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Ir and bilang atomiko 77. A very hard, brittle, pilak-puti transition metal of the platinum grupo, iridium is considered to be the second-densest metal (after osmium) with a density of 22.56 g/cm3 as defined by experimental X-ray crystallography. However, at room temperature and standard atmospheric pressure, iridium has been calculated to have a density of 22.65 g/cm3, 0.04 g/cm3 higher than osmium measured the same way. Still, the experimental X-ray crystallography value is considered to be the most accurate, as such iridium is considered to be the second densest element. It is the most corrosion-resistant metal, even at temperatures as high as 2000°C. Although only certain molten salts and halohens are corrosive to solido iridium, finely divided iridium dust is much more reactive and can be flammable.

title: iron
text: Iron (/ˈaɪərn/) ay isang elementong kemikal with symbol Fe (from Latin: ferrum) and bilang atomiko 26. It ay isang metal that belongs to the first transition serye and grupo 8 of the periodic table. It is by mass the most common element on Earth, forming much of Earth's outer and inner core. It is the fourth most common element in the Earth's crust.

title: krypton
text: Krypton (from Ancient Greek: κρυπτός, romanized: kryptos "the hidden one") ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Kr and bilang atomiko 36. It ay isang colorless, odorless, tasteless marangal na gas that occurs in trace amounts in the atmosphere and is often used with other bihira gases in fluorescent lamps. With bihira exceptions, krypton is chemically inert.

title: lanthanum
text: Ang lanthanum ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong La at atomic number na 57. Ito ay isang malambot, pilak-puting metal na kabilang sa serye ng lanthanide ng rare earth metals. Ang lanthanum ay natuklasan noong 1839 ng Swedish chemist na si Carl Gustaf Mosander. Ang pangalan ay nanggaling sa Greek na salita para sa nakatago. Ang lanthanum ay madaling nag-oxidize sa hangin at mabagal na reacts sa tubig. Ito ay ginagamit sa mga catalyst para sa oil refining, sa special optical glass, at sa mga electrode para sa carbon arc lamps.

title: lawrencium
text: Lawrencium ay isang sintetiko elementong kemikal na may simbolong Lr (formerly Lw) and bilang atomiko 103. It is named in honor of Ernest Lawrence, inventor of the cyclotron, a device that was used to discover many artificial radioaktibo elements. A radioaktibo metal, lawrencium is the eleventh transuranic element and ay isanglso the final member of the actinide serye. Like all elements with bilang atomiko over 100, lawrencium can only be produced in particle accelerators by bombarding lighter elements with charged particles. Thirteen isotopes of lawrencium are currently known; the most stable is Lr-266 with a half-life of 11 hours, but the shorter-lived Lr-260 (half-life 2.7 minutes) is most commonly used in chemistry because it can be produced on a larger scale.

title: lead
text: Lead (/ˈlɛd/) ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Pb (from the Latin plumbum) and bilang atomiko 82. It ay isang heavy metal that is denser than most common materials. Lead is soft and malleable, and also has a relatively low melting point. When freshly cut, lead is pilak with a hint of blue; it tarnishes to a dull abo color when exposed to air. Lead has the highest bilang atomiko of any stable element and three of its isotopes are endpoints of major nuclear decay chains of heavier elements.

title: lithium
text: Lithium (from Greek: λίθος, romanized: lithos, lit. 'stone') ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Li and bilang atomiko 3. It ay isang soft, pilak-puti alkali metal. Under standard conditions, it is the lightest metal and the lightest solido element. Like all alkali metals, lithium is highly reactive and flammable, and must be stored in mineral oil. When cut, it exhibits a metallic luster, but moist air corrodes it quickly to a dull pilak abo, then black tarnish. It never occurs freely in nature, but only in (usually ionic) compounds, such as pegmatitic minerals, which were once the main source of lithium. Due to its solubility as an ion, it is present in ocean water and is commonly obtained from brines. Lithium metal is isolated electrolytically from a mixture of lithium chloride and potassium chloride.

title: livermorium
text: Ang livermorium ay isang sintetikong elementong kemikal na may simbolong Lv at atomic number na 116. Ito ay isang lubhang radioactive transactinide. Ang elemento ay unang na-synthesize noong 2000 sa Joint Institute for Nuclear Research ng Russia na nakikipagtulungan sa Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory. Ito ay pinangalanan mula sa Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory at sa lungsod ng Livermore. Dahil sa sobrang maikling half-life nito, napakaliit lamang ng pananaliksik ang naisakatuparan sa mga properties ng livermorium. Inaasahang ito ay solid metal sa room temperature.

title: lutetium
text: Lutetium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Lu and bilang atomiko 71. It ay isang pilak puti metal, which resists corrosion in dry air, but not in moist air. Lutetium is the last element in the lanthanide serye, and it is traditionally counted among the bihira earths. Lutetium is sometimes considered the first element of the 6th-period mga metal na transisyon, although lanthanum is more often considered as such.

title: magnesium
text: Magnesium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Mg and bilang atomiko 12. It ay isang shiny abo solido which bears a close physical resemblance to the other five elements in the second column (grupo 2, or mga metal na alkalina) of the periodic table: all grupo 2 elements have the same electron configuration in the outer electron shell and a similar crystal structure.

title: manganese
text: Manganese ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Mn and bilang atomiko 25. It is often found in minerals in combination with iron. Manganese ay isang transition metal with a multifaceted array of industrial alloy uses, particularly in stainless steels.

title: meitnerium
text: Meitnerium ay isang sintetiko elementong kemikal na may simbolong Mt and bilang atomiko 109. It ay isangn extremely radioaktibo sintetiko element (an element not found in nature, but can be created in a laboratory). The most stable known isotope, meitnerium-278, has a half-life of 4.5 seconds, although the unconfirmed meitnerium-282 may have a longer half-life of 67 seconds. The GSI Helmholtz Centre for Heavy Ion Research near Darmstadt, Germany, first created this element in 1982. It is named after Lise Meitner.

title: mendelevium
text: Mendelevium ay isang sintetiko element na may simbolong Md (formerly Mv) and bilang atomiko 101. A metallic radioaktibo transuranic element in the actinide serye, it is the first element by bilang atomiko that currently cannot be produced in macroscopic quantities through neutron bombardment of lighter elements. It is the third-to-last actinide and the ninth transuranic element. It can only be produced in particle accelerators by bombarding lighter elements with charged particles. A total of seventeen mendelevium isotopes are known, the most stable being Md-258 with a half-life of 51 days; nevertheless, the shorter-lived Md-256 (half-life 1.17 hours) is most commonly used in chemistry because it can be produced on a larger scale.

title: mercury
text: Mercury ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Hg and bilang atomiko 80. It is commonly known as quicksilver and was formerly named hydrargyrum (/haɪˈdrɑːrdʒərəm/ hy-DRAR-jər-əm). A heavy, pilak d-block element, mercury is the only metallic element that is likido at standard conditions for temperature and pressure; the only other element that is likido under these conditions is the halohen bromine, though metals such as caesium, gallium, and rubidium melt just above room temperature.

title: molybdenum
text: Ang Molybdenum ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Mo at atomic number 42. Ang pangalan ay mula sa Neo-Latin na molybdaenum, mula sa Sinaunang Griyego na Μόλυβδος molybdos, na nangangahulugang tingga, dahil ang mga ore nito ay nalilito sa mga tinggang ore. Ang mga mineral ng molybdenum ay kilala sa buong kasaysayan, ngunit ang elemento ay natuklasan (sa kahulugan ng pagkakaiba nito bilang bagong entity mula sa mineral salts ng ibang mga metal) noong 1778 ni Carl Wilhelm Scheele. Ang metal ay unang inihiwalay noong 1781 ni Peter Jacob Hjelm.

title: moscovium
text: Ang Moscovium ay isang synthetic chemical element na may simbolong Mc at atomic number 115. Ito ay unang na-synthesize noong 2003 ng isang joint team ng mga Russian at American scientists sa Joint Institute for Nuclear Research (JINR) sa Dubna, Russia. Noong Disyembre 2015, kinikilala ito bilang isa sa apat na bagong elemento ng Working Group ng International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUPAC). Noong Nobyembre 28, 2016, opisyal na pinangalanan ito bilang moscovium pagkatapos ng Moscow region, na naglalarawan sa Moscow, Dubna, at JINR. Ito ay extremely radioactive; ang pinakamahaba ang buhay na kilalang isotope, moscovium-290, ay may half-life na humigit-kumulang 0.65 segundo.

title: neodymium
text: Neodymium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Nd and bilang atomiko 60. Neodymium belongs to the lanthanide serye and ay isang bihira-earth element. It ay isang hard, slightly malleable pilak metal that quickly tarnishes in air and moisture. When oxidized, neodymium reacts quickly to produce pink, purple/blue and yellow compounds in the +2, +3 and +4 oxidation states. Neodymium was discovered in 1885 by the Austrian chemist Carl Auer von Welsbach. It is present in significant quantities in the ore minerals monazite and bastnäsite. Neodymium is not found likas in metallic form or unmixed with other lanthanides, and it is usually refined for general use. Although neodymium is classed as a bihira-earth element, it is fairly common, no bihirar than cobalt, nickel, or copper, and is widely distributed in the Earth's crust. Most of the world's commercial neodymium is mined in China.

title: neon
text: Neon ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Ne and bilang atomiko 10. It ay isang marangal na gas. Neon ay isang colorless, odorless, inert monatomic gas under standard conditions, with about two-thirds the density of air. It was discovered (along with krypton and xenon) in 1898 as one of the three residual bihira inert elements remaining in dry air, after nitrogen, oxygen, argon and carbon dioxide were removed. Neon was the second of these three bihira gases to be discovered and was immediately recognized as a new element from its bright red emission spectrum. The name neon is derived from the Greek word, νέον, neuter singular form of νέος (neos), meaning new. Neon is chemically inert, and no uncharged neon compounds are known. The compounds of neon currently known include ionic molecules, molecules held together by van der Waals forces and clathrates.

title: neptunium
text: Ang neptunium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Np at atomic number na 93. Ito ay isang radioactive actinide metal at ang unang transuranic element na na-synthesize. Ang neptunium ay natuklasan noong 1940 nina Edwin McMillan at Philip Abelson sa University of California, Berkeley. Ito ay pinangalanan mula sa planetang Neptune, na lampas sa Uranus, sa analogy kung paano ang neptunium ay lampas sa uranium sa periodic table. Ang neptunium ay pangunahing ginagamit sa neutron detection at sa produksyon ng plutonium-238.

title: nickel
text: Nickel ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Ni and bilang atomiko 28. It ay isang pilak-puti lustrous metal with a slight golden tinge. Nickel belongs to the mga metal na transisyon and is hard and ductile. Pure nickel, powdered to maximize the reactive surface area, shows a significant chemical activity, but larger pieces are slow to react with air under standard conditions because an oxide layer forms on the surface and prevents further corrosion (passivation). Even so, pure native nickel is found in Earth's crust only in tiny amounts, usually in ultramafic rocks, and in the interiors of larger nickel–iron meteorites that were not exposed to oxygen when outside Earth's atmosphere.

title: nihonium
text: Ang nihonium ay isang sintetikong elementong kemikal na may simbolong Nh at atomic number na 113. Ito ay isang lubhang radioactive transactinide. Ang elemento ay unang na-synthesize noong 2003 ng isang koponan ng research sa RIKEN sa Japan. Ito ay pinangalanan mula sa Japan, kung saan ang Nihon ay isang Japanese na pangalan para sa bansa. Dahil sa sobrang maikling half-life nito at sa kahirapan ng paggawa nito, napakaliit lamang ng pananaliksik ang naisakatuparan sa mga chemical properties ng nihonium. Ito ay isa sa mga pinakabagong na-confirm na elemento.

title: niobium
text: Niobium, also known as columbium, ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Nb (formerly Cb) and bilang atomiko 41. Niobium ay isang light grey, crystalline, and ductile transition metal. Niobium oxidizes in the earth's atmosphere very slowly, hence its application in jewelry as a hypoallergenic alternative to nickel. Niobium is often found in the minerals pyrochlore and columbite, hence the former name "columbium". Its name comes from Greek mythology, specifically Niobe, who was the daughter of Tantalus, the namesake of tantalum. The name reflects the great similarity between the two elements in their physical and chemical properties, making them difficult to distinguish.

title: nitrogen
text: Ang Nitrogen ay ang elementong kemikal na may simbolong N at atomic number 7. Unang natuklasan at inihiwalay ito ng Scottish physician na si Daniel Rutherford noong 1772. Bagaman sina Carl Wilhelm Scheele at Henry Cavendish ay malayang gumawa nito sa parehong oras, si Rutherford ay karaniwang binibigyan ng kredito para sa pagtuklas. Ang nitrogen ay isang walang kulay at walang amoy na gas na bumubuo ng humigit-kumulang 78% ng atmosphere ng Earth sa pamamagitan ng dami. Ang nitrogen ay bumubuo ng mga protina at DNA at samakatuwid ay naroroon sa lahat ng nabubuhay na organismo.

title: nobelium
text: Nobelium ay isang sintetiko elementong kemikal na may simbolong Hindi and bilang atomiko 102. It is named in honor of Alfred Nobel, the inventor of dynamite and benefactor of science. A radioaktibo metal, it is the tenth transuranic element and is the penultimate member of the actinide serye. Like all elements with bilang atomiko over 100, nobelium can only be produced in particle accelerators by bombarding lighter elements with charged particles. A total of twelve nobelium isotopes are known to exist; the most stable is Hindi-259 with a half-life of 58 minutes, but the shorter-lived Hindi-255 (half-life 3.1 minutes) is most commonly used in chemistry because it can be produced on a larger scale.

title: oganesson
text: Ang oganesson ay isang sintetikong elementong kemikal na may simbolong Og at atomic number na 118. Ito ay ang pinakamabigat na kilalang elemento at kumpleto ang period 7 ng periodic table. Ang oganesson ay unang na-synthesize noong 2002 sa Joint Institute for Nuclear Research ng Russia. Ito ay pinangalanan mula sa Russian nuclear physicist na si Yuri Oganessian. Dahil sa sobrang maikling half-life nito, walang macroscopic na dami ng oganesson ang ginawa at napakaliit lamang ang alam tungkol sa mga properties nito. Ito ay preliminaryong na-classify bilang noble gas, ngunit inaasahang magkakaroon ng deviant na mga properties.

title: osmium
text: Ang osmium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Os at atomic number na 76. Ito ay isang matigas, marupok, asul-puting transition metal sa platinum group. Ang osmium ay natuklasan noong 1803 ng English chemist na si Smithson Tennant. Ang pangalan ay nanggaling sa Greek na salita para sa amoy dahil sa malakas na amoy ng oxide nito. Ang osmium ay may pinakamataas na density sa lahat ng natural na nangyayaring elemento. Ito ay ginagamit sa mga alloy na may platinum at iridium para sa matibay na fountain pen nibs, electrical contacts, at iba pang mga aplikasyon na nangangailangan ng matinding tigas.

title: oxygen
text: Ang oxygen ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong O at atomic number na 8. Ito ay isang walang kulay, walang amoy na gas na bumubuo ng humigit-kumulang 21% ng Earth's atmosphere. Ang oxygen ay natuklasan nang independiyente ng dalawang chemist, sina Carl Wilhelm Scheele noong 1772 at Joseph Priestley noong 1774. Ang pangalan ay nanggaling sa Greek na mga salita para sa acid-former. Ang oxygen ay essential para sa karamihan ng mga anyo ng buhay sa pamamagitan ng cellular respiration. Ito ay ginagamit sa industriya para sa steel production, chemical processing, at medikal na mga layunin.

title: palladium
text: Palladium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Pd and bilang atomiko 46. It ay isang bihira and lustrous pilak-puti metal discovered in 1803 by the English chemist William Hyde Wollaston. He named it after the asteroid Pallas, which was itself named after the epithet of the Greek goddess Athena, acquired by her when she slew Pallas. Palladium, platinum, rhodium, ruthenium, iridium and osmium form a grupo of elements referred to as the platinum grupo metals (PGMs). They have similar chemical properties, but palladium has the lowest melting point and is the least dense of them.

title: phosphorus
text: Phosphorus ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong P and bilang atomiko 15. Elemental phosphorus exists in two major forms, puti phosphorus and red phosphorus, but because it is highly reactive, phosphorus is never found as a free element on Earth. It has a concentration in the Earth's crust of about one gram per kilogram (compare copper at about 0.06 grams). In minerals, phosphorus generally occurs as phosphate.

title: platinum
text: Platinum ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Pt and bilang atomiko 78. It ay isang dense, malleable, ductile, highly unreactive, precious, silverish-puti transition metal. Its name is derived from the Spanish term platino, meaning "little silver".

title: plutonium
text: Ang plutonium ay isang radioactive na elementong kemikal na may simbolong Pu at atomic number na 94. Ito ay isang actinide metal na may pilak na kulay na nag-oxidize papunta sa matte gray. Ang plutonium ay unang na-synthesize noong 1940 nina Glenn T. Seaborg at ng kanyang koponan sa University of California, Berkeley. Ito ay pinangalanan mula sa dwarf planet na Pluto. Ang plutonium ay fissile at ginagamit bilang fuel sa mga nuclear reactor at sa nuclear weapons. Kahit na maliliit na dami ng plutonium ay lubhang nakakalason at radioactive.

title: polonium
text: Ang polonium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Po at atomic number na 84. Ito ay isang bihirang, lubhang radioactive metal. Ang polonium ay natuklasan noong 1898 nina Marie at Pierre Curie at pinangalanan mula sa homeland ni Marie na Poland. Ito ay ang unang elemento na natuklasan sa pamamagitan ng radioactivity nito. Ang polonium ay nag-emit ng alpha radiation at ginagamit bilang heat source sa mga space probe at bilang anti-static device. Dahil sa matinding radioactivity at toxicity nito, ang polonium ay dapat hawakan nang may lubhang pag-iingat.

title: potassium
text: Ang Potassium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong K (mula sa Neo-Latin na kalium) at atomic number 19. Ang Potassium ay isang pilak-puting metal na sapat na malambot upang putulin ng kutsilyo na may kaunting lakas. Ang potassium metal ay mabilis na tumutugon sa atmospheric oxygen upang makabuo ng flaky white potassium peroxide sa loob lamang ng ilang segundo ng pagkakalantad. Ito ay unang inihiwalay mula sa potash, ang abo ng mga halaman, kung saan ang pangalan nito ay nagmula. Sa periodic table, ang potassium ay isa sa alkali metals, lahat ng mga ito ay may isang electron sa kanilang pinakalapit na electron shell.

title: praseodymium
text: Praseodymium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Pr and bilang atomiko 59. It is the third member of the lanthanide serye and is traditionally considered to be one of the bihira-earth metals. Praseodymium ay isang soft, pilak, malleable and ductile metal, valued for its magnetic, electrical, chemical, and optical properties. It is too reactive to be found in native form, and pure praseodymium metal slowly develops a green oxide coating when exposed to air.

title: promethium
text: Ang promethium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Pm at atomic number na 61. Ito ay isang bihirang radioactive lanthanide metal. Ang promethium ay unang na-isolate noong 1945 nina Jacob A. Marinsky, Lawrence E. Glendenin, at Charles D. Coryell sa Oak Ridge National Laboratory. Ito ay pinangalanan mula kay Prometheus ng Greek mythology. Ang promethium ay hindi natural na nangyayari sa Earth sa makabuluhang dami. Ito ay ginagamit sa luminous paint, atomic-powered pacemakers, at bilang radiation source sa thickness gauges.

title: protactinium
text: Protactinium (formerly protoactinium) ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Pa and bilang atomiko 91. It ay isang dense, pilak-abo actinide metal which readily reacts with oxygen, water vapor and inorganic acids. It forms various chemical compounds in which protactinium is usually present in the oxidation state +5, but it can also assume +4 and even +3 or +2 states. Concentrations of protactinium in the Earth's crust are typically a few parts per trillion, but may reach up to a few parts per million in some uraninite ore deposits. Because of its scarcity, high radioactivity and high toxicity, there are currently no uses for protactinium outside scientific research, and for this purpose, protactinium is mostly extracted from spent nuclear fuel.

title: radium
text: Radium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Ra and bilang atomiko 88. It is the sixth element in grupo 2 of the periodic table, also known as the mga metal na alkalina. Pure radium is pilak-puti, but it readily reacts with nitrogen (rather than oxygen) on exposure to air, forming a black surface layer of radium nitride (Ra3N2). All isotopes of radium are highly radioaktibo, with the most stable isotope being radium-226, which has a half-life of 1600 years and decays into radon gas (specifically the isotope radon-222). When radium decays, ionizing radiation ay isang product, which can excite fluorescent chemicals and cause radioluminescence.

title: radon
text: Radon ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Rn and bilang atomiko 86. It ay isang radioaktibo, colorless, odorless, tasteless marangal na gas. It occurs likas in minute quantities as an intermediate step in the normal radioaktibo decay chains through which thorium and uranium slowly decay into lead and various other short-lived radioaktibo elements. Radon itself is the immediate decay product of radium. Its most stable isotope, Rn-222, has a half-life of 3.8 days, making radon one of the bihirast elements since it decays so quickly. Since thorium and uranium are two of the most common radioaktibo elements on Earth, and they have three isotopes with very long half-lives (on the order of several billion years) radon will be present on Earth long into the future in spite of its short half-life as it is continually being generated. The decay of radon produces many other short-lived nuclides known as radon daughters, ending at stable isotopes of lead.

title: rhenium
text: Rhenium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Re and bilang atomiko 75. It ay isang pilak-abo, heavy, third-row transition metal in grupo 7 of the periodic table. With an estimated average concentration of 1 part per billion (ppb), rhenium is one of the bihirast elements in the Earth's crust. Rhenium has the third-highest melting point and second-highest boiling point of any stable element at 5903 K. Rhenium resembles manganese and technetium chemically and is mainly obtained as a by-product of the extraction and refinement of molybdenum and copper ores. Rhenium shows in its compounds a wide variety of oxidation states ranging from −1 to +7.

title: rhodium
text: Rhodium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Rh and bilang atomiko 45. It ay isang bihira, pilak-puti, hard, corrosion-resistant, and chemically inert transition metal. It ay isang noble metal and a member of the platinum grupo. It has only one likas nagaganap isotope, Rh-103. Naturally nagaganap rhodium is usually found as free metal, as an alloy with similar metals, and bihiraly as a chemical compound in minerals such as bowieite and rhodplumsite. It is one of the bihirast and most valuable precious metals.

title: roentgenium
text: Roentgenium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Rg and bilang atomiko 111. It ay isangn extremely radioaktibo sintetiko element that can be created in a laboratory but is not found in nature. The most stable known isotope, roentgenium-282, has a half-life of 100 seconds, although the unconfirmed roentgenium-286 may have a longer half-life of about 10.7 minutes. Roentgenium was first created in 1994 by the GSI Helmholtz Centre for Heavy Ion Research near Darmstadt, Germany. It is named after the physicist Wilhelm Röntgen (also spelled Roentgen), who discovered X-rays

title: rubidium
text: Ang rubidium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Rb at atomic number na 37. Ito ay isang malambot, pilak-puting alkali metal na lubhang reactive. Ang rubidium ay natuklasan noong 1861 nina German chemist na sina Robert Bunsen at Gustav Kirchhoff. Ang pangalan ay nanggaling sa Latin na salita para sa deep red dahil sa mga red spectral lines nito. Ang rubidium ay madaling nag-ignite spontaneously sa hangin at reacts nang marahas sa tubig. Ito ay ginagamit sa atomic clocks, photocells, at sa electronic vacuum tubes.

title: ruthenium
text: Ang ruthenium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Ru at atomic number na 44. Ito ay isang bihirang transition metal na kabilang sa platinum group. Ang ruthenium ay natuklasan noong 1844 ng Russian chemist na si Karl Ernst Claus. Ang pangalan ay nanggaling sa Ruthenia, ang Latin na anyo para sa Russia. Ang ruthenium ay napakatigas at resistant sa corrosion. Ito ay pangunahing ginagamit bilang alloying agent upang magpatigas ng platinum at palladium, pati na rin sa mga electrical contacts at thick film resistors.

title: rutherfordium
text: Rutherfordium ay isang sintetiko elementong kemikal na may simbolong Rf and bilang atomiko 104, named after New Zealand physicist Ernest Rutherford. As a sintetiko element, it is not found in nature and can only be created in a laboratory. It is radioaktibo; the most stable known isotope, Rf-267, has a half-life of approximately 1.3 hours.

title: samarium
text: Samarium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Sm and bilang atomiko 62. It ay isang moderately hard pilak metal that slowly oxidizes in air. Being a typical member of the lanthanide serye, samarium usually assumes the oxidation state +3. Compounds of samarium(II) are also known, most notably the monoxide SmO, monochalcogenides SmS, SmSe and SmTe, as well as samarium(II) iodide. The last compound ay isang common reducing agent in chemical synthesis. Samarium has no significant biological role but is only slightly toxic

title: scandium
text: Scandium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Sc and bilang atomiko 21. A pilak-puti metallic d-block element, it has historically been classified as a bihira-earth element, together with yttrium and the lanthanides. It was discovered in 1879 by spectral analysis of the minerals euxenite and gadolinite from Scandinavia.

title: seaborgium
text: Seaborgium ay isang sintetiko elementong kemikal na may simbolong Sg and bilang atomiko 106. It is named after the American nuclear chemist Glenn T. Seaborg. As a sintetiko element, it can be created in a laboratory but is not found in nature. It ay isanglso radioaktibo; the most stable known isotope, Sg-269, has a half-life of approximately 14 minutes

title: selenium
text: Ang selenium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Se at atomic number na 34. Ito ay isang non-metal na may mga properties na intermediate sa pagitan ng sulfur at tellurium. Ang selenium ay natuklasan noong 1817 ng Swedish chemist na si Jöns Jacob Berzelius. Ang pangalan ay nanggaling sa Greek na salita para sa buwan, selene. Ang selenium ay essential para sa maraming organismo sa maliliit na dami ngunit nakakalason sa mas malalaking dosis. Ito ay ginagamit sa photocells, photocopier, solar cells, at bilang additive sa salamin upang magbigay ng pula na kulay.

title: silicon
text: Ang silicon ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Si at atomic number na 14. Ito ay isang matigas, marupok crystalline solid na may asul-abong metallic luster. Ang silicon ay unang na-isolate noong 1824 ng Swedish chemist na si Jöns Jacob Berzelius. Ang pangalan ay nanggaling sa Latin na salitang silex na nangangahulugang flint. Ang silicon ay ang pangalawang pinaka-karaniwang elemento sa earth's crust pagkatapos ng oxygen. Ito ay pundasyon ng electronics at semiconductor technology at ginagamit sa paggawa ng glass, cement, at ceramics.

title: silver
text: Silver ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Ag (from the Latin argentum, derived from the Proto-Indo-European h₂erǵ: "shiny" or "puti") and bilang atomiko 47. A soft, puti, lustrous transition metal, it exhibits the highest electrical conductivity, thermal conductivity, and reflectivity of any metal. The metal is found in the Earth's crust in the pure, free elemental form ("native silver"), as an alloy with gold and other metals, and in minerals such as argentite and chlorargyrite. Most silver is produced as a byproduct of copper, gold, lead, and zinc refining.

title: sodium
text: Sodium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Na (from Latin "natrium") and bilang atomiko 11. It ay isang soft, pilak-puti, highly reactive metal. Sodium ay isangn alkali metal, being in grupo 1 of the periodic table. Its only stable isotope is Na-23. The free metal does not occur in nature, and must be prepared from compounds. Sodium is the sixth most abundant element in the Earth's crust and exists in numerous minerals such as feldspars, sodalite, and rock salt (NaCl). Many salts of sodium are highly water-soluble: sodium ions have been leached by the action of water from the Earth's minerals over eons, and thus sodium and chlorine are the most common dissolved elements by weight in the oceans.

title: strontium
text: Ang strontium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Sr at atomic number na 38. Ito ay isang malambot, pilak-puting alkaline earth metal na reactive. Ang strontium ay natuklasan noong 1790 ng Scottish chemist na sina Adair Crawford at William Cruickshank. Ito ay pinangalanan mula sa lungsod ng Strontian sa Scotland kung saan ito unang natagpuan. Ang strontium ay mayroon natural na nangyayaring isotopes at maraming radioactive isotopes. Ang strontium-90 ay isang radioactive isotope na ginagamit sa cancer treatment. Ang strontium salts ay ginagamit sa paggawa ng fireworks at flares na nagbibigay ng pula na kulay.

title: sulfur
text: Sulfur (in British English, sulphur) ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong S and bilang atomiko 16. It ay isangbundant, multivalent and nonmetallic. Under normal conditions, sulfur atoms form cyclic octatomic molecules with a chemical formula S8. Elemental sulfur ay isang bright yellow, crystalline solido at room temperature.

title: tantalum
text: Tantalum ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Ta and bilang atomiko 73. Previously known as tantalium, it is named after Tantalus, a villain from Greek mythology. Tantalum ay isang bihira, hard, blue-abo, lustrous transition metal that is highly corrosion-resistant. It is part of the refractory metals grupo, which are widely used as minor components in alloys. The chemical inertness of tantalum makes it a valuable substance for laboratory equipment, and as a substitute for platinum. Its main use today is in tantalum capacitors in electronic equipment such as mobile phones, DVD players, video game systems and computers. Tantalum, always together with the chemically similar niobium, occurs in the mineral grupos tantalite, columbite and coltan (a mix of columbite and tantalite, though not recognised as a separate mineral species). Tantalum is considered a technology-critical element.

title: technetium
text: Technetium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Tc and bilang atomiko 43. It is the lightest element whose isotopes are all radioaktibo, none of which is stable other than the fully-ionized state of Tc-97. Nearly all available technetium is produced as a sintetiko element, and only about 18,000 tons are estimated to exist at any given time in the Earth's crust. Naturally-nagaganap technetium ay isang spontaneous fission product in uranium ore and thorium ore, the most common source, or the product of neutron capture in molybdenum ores. The pilak abo, crystalline transition metal lies between manganese and rhenium in grupo 7 of the periodic table, and its chemical properties are intermediate between those of both adjacent elements. The most common likas-nagaganap isotope is Tc-99.

title: tellurium
text: Tellurium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Te and bilang atomiko 52. It ay isang brittle, mildly toxic, bihira, silver-puti metaloid. Tellurium is chemically related to selenium and sulfur, all three of which are chalcogens. It is occasionally found in native form as elemental crystals. Tellurium is far more common in the Universe as a whole than on Earth. Its extreme rarity in the Earth's crust, comparable to that of platinum, is due partly to its formation of a volatile hydride that caused tellurium to be lost to space as a gas during the hot nebular formation of Earth, and partly to tellurium's low affinity for oxygen, which causes it to bind preferentially to other chalcophiles in dense minerals that sink into the core.

title: tennessine
text: Ang tennessine ay isang sintetikong elementong kemikal na may simbolong Ts at atomic number na 117. Ito ay isang lubhang radioactive transactinide at isa sa mga pinakabagong natuklasang elemento. Ang tennessine ay unang na-synthesize noong 2009 sa pamamagitan ng collaboration sa pagitan ng mga researcher sa Russia at sa USA. Ito ay pinangalanan mula sa estado ng Tennessee at sa rehiyon ng Tennessee na kinabibilangan ng Oak Ridge National Laboratory. Dahil sa sobrang maikling half-life nito, napakaliit lamang ng pananaliksik ang naisakatuparan sa mga chemical properties ng tennessine.

title: terbium
text: Terbium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Tb and bilang atomiko 65. It ay isang pilak-puti, bihira earth metal that is malleable, ductile, and soft enough to be cut with a knife. The ninth member of the lanthanide serye, terbium ay isang fairly electropositive metal that reacts with water, evolving hydrogen gas. Terbium is never found in nature as a free element, but it is contained in many minerals, including cerite, gadolinite, monazite, xenotime, and euxenite.

title: thallium
text: Thallium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Tl and bilang atomiko 81. It ay isang abo post-transition metal that is not found free in nature. When isolated, thallium resembles tin, but discolors when exposed to air. Chemists William Crookes and Claude-Auguste Lamy discovered thallium independently in 1861, in residues of sulfuric acid production. Both used the newly developed method of flame spectroscopy, in which thallium produces a notable green spectral line. Thallium, from Greek θαλλός, thallós, meaning "a green shoot or twig", was named by Crookes. It was isolated by both Lamy and Crookes in 1862; Lamy by electrolysis, and Crookes by precipitation and melting of the resultant powder. Crookes exhibited it as a powder precipitated by zinc at the International exhibition, which opened on 1 May that year.

title: thorium
text: Thorium ay isang weakly radioaktibo metallic elementong kemikal na may simbolong Th and bilang atomiko 90. Thorium is pilak and tarnishes black when it is exposed to air, forming thorium dioxide; it is moderately hard, malleable, and has a high melting point. Thorium ay isangn electropositive actinide whose chemistry is dominated by the +4 oxidation state; it is quite reactive and can ignite in air when finely divided.

title: thulium
text: Thulium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Tm and bilang atomiko 69. It is the thirteenth and third-last element in the lanthanide serye. Like the other lanthanides, the most common oxidation state is +3, seen in its oxide, halides and other compounds; because it occurs so late in the serye, however, the +2 oxidation state ay isanglso stabilized by the nearly full 4f shell that results. In aqueous solution, like compounds of other late lanthanides, soluble thulium compounds form coordination complexes with nine water molecules.

title: tin
text: Tin ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Sn (from Latin: stannum) and bilang atomiko 50. Tin ay isang pilak metal that characteristically has a faint yellow hue. Tin, like indium, is soft enough to be cut without much force. When a bar of tin is bent, the so-called “tin cry” can be heard as a result of sliding tin crystals reforming; this trait is shared by indium, cadmium, and frozen mercury.

title: titanium
text: Titanium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Ti and bilang atomiko 22. It ay isang lustrous transition metal with a silver color, low density, and high strength. Titanium is resistant to corrosion in sea water, aqua regia, and chlorine.

title: tungsten
text: Tungsten, or wolfram,[8][9] ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong W and bilang atomiko 74. The name tungsten comes from the former Swedish name for the tungstate mineral scheelite, tungsten which means "heavy stone". Tungsten ay isang bihira metal found likas on Earth almost exclusively combined with other elements in chemical compounds rather than alone. It was identified as a new element in 1781 and first isolated as a metal in 1783. Its important ores include wolframite and scheelite.

title: uranium
text: Uranium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong U and bilang atomiko 92. It ay isang pilak-grey metal in the actinide serye of the periodic table. A uranium atom has 92 protons and 92 electrons, of which 6 are valence electrons. Uranium is weakly radioaktibo because all isotopes of uranium are unstable; the half-lives of its likas nagaganap isotopes range between 159,200 years and 4.5 billion years. The most common isotopes in natural uranium are uranium-238 (which has 146 neutrons and accounts for over 99% of uranium on Earth) and uranium-235 (which has 143 neutrons). Uranium has the highest atomic weight of the primordially nagaganap elements. Its density ay isangbout 70% higher than that of lead, and slightly lower than that of gold or tungsten. It occurs likas in low concentrations of a few parts per million in soil, rock and water, and is commercially extracted from uranium-bearing minerals such as uraninite.

title: vanadium
text: Ang vanadium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong V at atomic number na 23. Ito ay isang matigas, pilak-puting transition metal. Ang vanadium ay unang natuklasan noong 1801 ng Mexican chemist na si Andrés Manuel del Río, ngunit ang kanyang discovery ay tinanggihan. Ito ay na-rediscover noong 1830 ng Swedish chemist na si Nils Gabriel Sefström, na nagbigay ng pangalan dito mula sa Norse goddess na Vanadis. Ang vanadium ay pangunahing ginagamit sa mga steel alloy upang dagdagan ang lakas at toughness. Ito rin ay essential para sa ilang mga organismo.

title: xenon
text: Xenon ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Xe and bilang atomiko 54. It ay isang colorless, dense, odorless marangal na gas found in Earth's atmosphere in trace amounts.[11] Although generally unreactive, xenon can undergo a few chemical reactions such as the formation of xenon hexafluoroplatinate, the first marangal na gas compound to be synthesized.

title: ytterbium
text: Ytterbium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Yb and bilang atomiko 70. It is the fourteenth and penultimate element in the lanthanide serye, which is the basis of the relative stability of its +2 oxidation state. However, like the other lanthanides, its most common oxidation state is +3, as in its oxide, halides, and other compounds. In aqueous solution, like compounds of other late lanthanides, soluble ytterbium compounds form complexes with nine water molecules. Because of its closed-shell electron configuration, its density and melting and boiling points differ significantly from those of most other lanthanides.

title: yttrium
text: Yttrium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Y and bilang atomiko 39. It ay isang pilak-metallic transition metal chemically similar to the lanthanides and has often been classified as a "bihira-earth element". Yttrium ay isanglmost always found in combination with lanthanide elements in bihira-earth minerals, and is never found in nature as a free element. Y-89 is the only stable isotope, and the only isotope found in the Earth's crust.

title: zinc
text: Zinc ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Zn and bilang atomiko 30. Zinc ay isang slightly brittle metal at room temperature and has a blue-pilak anyo when oxidation is removed. It is the first element in grupo 12 of the periodic table. In some respects, zinc is chemically similar to magnesium: both elements exhibit only one normal oxidation state (+2), and the Zn2+ and Mg2+ ions are of similar size. Zinc is the 24th most abundant element in Earth's crust and has five stable isotopes. The most common zinc ore is sphalerite (zinc blende), a zinc sulfide mineral. The largest workable lodes are in Australia, Asia, and the United States. Zinc is refined by froth flotation of the ore, roasting, and final extraction using electricity (electrowinning).

title: zirconium
text: Zirconium ay isang elementong kemikal na may simbolong Zr and bilang atomiko 40. The name zirconium is taken from the name of the mineral zircon (the word is related to Persian zargun (zircon; zar-gun, "gold-like" or "as gold")), the most important source of zirconium. It ay isang lustrous, grey-puti, strong transition metal that closely resembles hafnium and, to a lesser extent, titanium. Zirconium is mainly used as a refractory and opacifier, although small amounts are used as an alloying agent for its strong resistance to corrosion. Zirconium forms a variety of inorganic and organometallic compounds such as zirconium dioxide and zirconocene dichloride, respectively. Five isotopes occur likas, three of which are stable. Zirconium compounds have no known biological role.

title: actinium
text: L'actinium est un élément chimique de symbole Ac et de numéro atomique 89. Il a été isolé pour la première fois par le chimiste français André-Louis Debierne en 1899. Friedrich Oskar Giesel l'a ensuite isolé indépendamment en 1902 et, ignorant qu'il était déjà connu, lui a donné le nom d'emanium. L'actinium a donné son nom à la série des actinides, un groupe de 15 éléments similaires entre l'actinium et le lawrencium dans le tableau périodique. Il est également parfois considéré comme le premier des métaux de transition de la 7e période, bien que le lawrencium se voie moins souvent attribuer cette position. Avec le polonium, le radium et le radon, l'actinium a été l'un des premiers éléments radioactifs non primordiaux à être isolé.

title: aluminium
text: L'aluminium (aluminum en anglais américain et canadien) est un élément chimique de symbole Al et de numéro atomique 13. C'est un métal argenté, mou, non magnétique et ductile du groupe du bore. En masse, l'aluminium constitue environ 8% de la croûte terrestre, où il est le troisième élément le plus abondant (après l'oxygène et le silicium) et également le métal le plus abondant. La présence d'aluminium diminue toutefois dans le manteau terrestre en dessous. Le principal minerai d'aluminium est la bauxite. Le métal aluminium est très réactif, de sorte que les spécimens natifs sont rares et limités à des environnements extrêmement réducteurs. Au lieu de cela, il se trouve combiné dans plus de 270 minéraux différents.

title: americium
text: L'américium est un élément chimique radioactif synthétique de symbole Am et de numéro atomique 95. C'est un membre transuranien de la série des actinides, situé dans le tableau périodique sous l'élément lanthanide europium, et a donc été nommé par analogie d'après les Amériques.

title: antimony
text: L'antimoine est un élément chimique de symbole Sb (du latin : stibium) et de numéro atomique 51. Métalloïde gris lustré, on le trouve dans la nature principalement sous forme de sulfure minéral stibine (Sb2S3). Les composés d'antimoine sont connus depuis l'Antiquité et étaient réduits en poudre pour une utilisation en médecine et en cosmétique, souvent connus sous le nom arabe de khôl. L'antimoine métallique était également connu, mais il a été identifié à tort comme du plomb lors de sa découverte. La première description connue du métal en Occident a été écrite en 1540 par Vannoccio Biringuccio.

title: argon
text: L'argon est un élément chimique de symbole Ar et de numéro atomique 18. Il appartient au groupe 18 du tableau périodique et est un gaz noble. L'argon est le troisième gaz le plus abondant dans l'atmosphère terrestre, à 0,934% (9340 ppmv). Il est plus de deux fois plus abondant que la vapeur d'eau (qui représente en moyenne environ 4000 ppmv, mais varie considérablement), 23 fois plus abondant que le dioxyde de carbone (400 ppmv) et plus de 500 fois plus abondant que le néon (18 ppmv). L'argon est l'élément le plus abondant dans l'atmosphère terrestre qui n'est pas un composé chimique.

title: arsenic
text: L'arsenic est un élément chimique de symbole As et de numéro atomique 33. L'arsenic se trouve dans de nombreux minéraux, généralement en combinaison avec le soufre et les métaux, mais aussi sous forme de cristal élémentaire pur. L'arsenic est un métalloïde. Il a diverses apparences allotropiques, mais seule la forme grise, qui a une structure cristalline métallique, est importante industriellement. Le principal minerai d'arsenic est l'arsénopyrite. L'arsenic est utilisé dans les diodes, les lasers et les semi-conducteurs. Il est également utilisé comme agent de dopage dans les semi-conducteurs pour les appareils à semi-conducteurs.

title: astatine
text: L'astate est un élément chimique radioactif de symbole At et de numéro atomique 85. C'est l'élément naturel le plus rare de la croûte terrestre, ne se produisant que comme produit de désintégration de divers éléments plus lourds. Tous les isotopes de l'astate ont une courte demi-vie; le plus stable est l'astate-210, avec une demi-vie de 8,1 heures. Un échantillon de l'élément pur n'a jamais été assemblé, car tout échantillon macroscopique serait immédiatement vaporisé par la chaleur de sa propre radioactivité.

title: barium
text: Le baryum est un élément chimique de symbole Ba et de numéro atomique 56. C'est le cinquième élément du groupe 2 et est un métal mou, argenté et alcalino-terreux. En raison de sa haute réactivité chimique, le baryum n'est jamais trouvé dans la nature comme élément libre. Les composés les plus courants sont le sulfate de baryum (BaSO4) et le carbonate de baryum (BaCO3), tous deux insolubles dans l'eau. Le nom baryum provient du mot grec ancien βαρύς (barys), signifiant "lourd".

title: berkelium
text: Le berkélium est un élément chimique transuranien radioactif synthétique de symbole Bk et de numéro atomique 97. C'est un membre de la série des actinides et des éléments transuraniens. Le berkélium a été découvert pour la première fois en décembre 1949 à l'Université de Californie à Berkeley, et a ainsi reçu son nom. C'était le cinquième élément transuranien découvert après le neptunium, le plutonium, le curium et l'américium.

title: beryllium
text: Le béryllium est un élément chimique de symbole Be et de numéro atomique 4. C'est un métal alcalino-terreux blanc-gris acier, rigide, léger et cassant. C'est un métal divalent qui se trouve naturellement uniquement en combinaison avec d'autres éléments dans les minéraux. Les pierres précieuses remarquables qui contiennent du béryllium incluent le béryl (aiguemarine, émeraude) et la chrysobéryl. En tant qu'élément de structure d'alliage, le béryllium a uniquement trouvé un succès commercial limité.

title: bismuth
text: Le bismuth est un élément chimique de symbole Bi et de numéro atomique 83. C'est un métal post-transition pentavalent et l'un des pnictogènes aux propriétés chimiques ressemblant à ses homologues plus légers, l'arsenic et l'antimoine. Le bismuth élémentaire peut se produire naturellement, bien que ses sulfures et oxydes constituent d'importants minerais commerciaux. L'élément libre est 86% aussi dense que le plomb. C'est un métal cassant avec une teinte blanc argenté lorsqu'il est fraîchement produit, mais la corrosion de surface peut lui donner une teinte rose iridescente.

title: bohrium
text: Le bohrium est un élément chimique de symbole Bh et de numéro atomique 107. C'est un élément synthétique (un élément qui peut être créé en laboratoire mais qui ne se trouve pas dans la nature) et est radioactif; l'isotope le plus stable connu, le bohrium-270, a une demi-vie d'environ 61 secondes. Dans le tableau périodique, c'est un métal de transition du groupe 7, un membre de la 7e période et est placé dans le groupe du manganèse, bien qu'aucune expérience chimique n'ait été menée pour confirmer qu'il se comporte comme l'homologue plus lourd du rhénium dans le groupe 7.

title: boron
text: Le bore est un élément chimique de symbole B et de numéro atomique 5. Produit entièrement par la spallation cosmique et par la nucléosynthèse des supernovæ, c'est un élément rare dans le système solaire et dans la croûte terrestre. Les composés de bore, principalement l'oxyde de bore et le borate de sodium, sont utilisés dans les industries du verre et de la céramique depuis des milliers d'années. Dans sa forme cristalline, le bore est un semi-conducteur extrêmement dur et presque inerte qui ressemble à un métalloïde noir et lustré.

title: bromine
text: Le brome est un élément chimique de symbole Br et de numéro atomique 35. C'est le troisième halogène le plus léger et est un liquide rouge fumant à température ambiante qui s'évapore facilement pour former un gaz rouge jaunâtre de couleur similaire. Ses propriétés sont intermédiaires entre celles du chlore et de l'iode. Isolé indépendamment par deux chimistes, Carl Jacob Löwig (en 1825) et Antoine Jérôme Balard (en 1826), son nom a été dérivé du grec ancien bromos ("puanteur"), se référant à son odeur âcre et désagréable.

title: cadmium
text: Le cadmium est un élément chimique de symbole Cd et de numéro atomique 48. Ce métal mou, blanc bleuâtre est chimiquement similaire aux deux autres métaux stables du groupe 12, le zinc et le mercure. Comme le zinc, il préfère l'état d'oxydation +2 dans la plupart de ses composés, et comme le mercure, il a un point de fusion inférieur à celui des métaux de transition des groupes 3 à 11. Le cadmium et ses congénères du groupe 12 ne sont pas toujours considérés comme des métaux de transition, car ils n'ont pas d'orbitale d ou f partiellement remplie dans aucun de leurs états d'oxydation courants.

title: caesium
text: Le césium est un élément chimique de symbole Cs et de numéro atomique 55. C'est un métal alcalin mou, blanc argenté avec un point de fusion de 28,5 °C (83,3 °F), ce qui en fait l'un des cinq seuls métaux liquides à température ambiante ou proche. Le césium a des propriétés physiques et chimiques similaires à celles du rubidium et du potassium. Le métal est extrêmement réactif et pyrophorique, s'enflammant spontanément dans l'air. C'est le plus électropositif et le plus alcalin des éléments naturels stables.

title: calcium
text: Le calcium est un élément chimique de symbole Ca et de numéro atomique 20. En tant que métal alcalino-terreux, le calcium est un métal mou gris réactif qui forme une couche d'oxyde sombre à l'air. Ses propriétés physiques et chimiques sont très similaires à celles de ses homologues plus lourds, le strontium et le baryum. C'est le cinquième élément le plus abondant dans la croûte terrestre et le troisième métal le plus abondant, après le fer et l'aluminium. Le composé de calcium le plus courant sur Terre est le carbonate de calcium, que l'on trouve dans le calcaire et les restes fossilisés de la vie marine primitive.

title: californium
text: Le californium est un élément chimique radioactif de symbole Cf et de numéro atomique 98. L'élément a été synthétisé pour la première fois en 1950 au laboratoire de radiations Lawrence de l'Université de Californie, Berkeley, en bombardant du curium avec des particules alpha (ions hélium-4). C'est un élément actinide, le sixième élément transuranien à être synthétisé, et possède le deuxième poids atomique le plus élevé de tous les éléments qui ont été produits en quantités suffisantes pour voir à l'œil nu (après l'einsteinium).

title: carbon
text: Le carbone est un élément chimique de symbole C et de numéro atomique 6. C'est un non-métal et tétravalent - faisant quatre électrons disponibles pour former des liaisons chimiques covalentes. Il appartient au groupe 14 du tableau périodique. Le carbone ne représente que 0,025 % de la croûte terrestre, mais il est crucial pour la vie. Trois isotopes se produisent naturellement, le 12C et le 13C étant stables, tandis que le 14C est un radionucléide, se désintégrant avec une demi-vie d'environ 5730 ans. Le carbone est l'un des rares éléments connus depuis l'Antiquité.

title: cerium
text: Le cérium est un élément chimique de symbole Ce et de numéro atomique 58. Le cérium est un métal gris doux, ductile et argenté qui se ternit lorsqu'il est exposé à l'air, et il est suffisamment mou pour être coupé avec un couteau en acier. Le cérium est le deuxième élément de la série des lanthanides et, bien qu'il affiche souvent l'état d'oxydation +3 caractéristique de la série, il présente également l'état +4 de manière exceptionnelle chez les lanthanides. Le cérium n'a pas de rôle biologique connu chez les humains mais n'est pas particulièrement toxique.

title: chlorine
text: Le chlore est un élément chimique de symbole Cl et de numéro atomique 17. Le deuxième halogène le plus léger, il apparaît entre le fluor et le brome dans le tableau périodique et ses propriétés sont principalement intermédiaires entre elles. Le chlore est un gaz vert jaunâtre à température ambiante. C'est un élément extrêmement réactif et un agent oxydant fort : parmi les éléments, il a la troisième plus haute électronégativité, derrière seulement l'oxygène et le fluor.

title: chromium
text: Le chrome est un élément chimique de symbole Cr et de numéro atomique 24. C'est le premier élément du groupe 6. C'est un métal de transition dur, lustré, gris acier et très fragile. Le chrome est le principal élément d'addition dans l'acier inoxydable, auquel il confère ses propriétés anti-corrosives. Le chrome est également très apprécié comme métal qui est capable de prendre un poli élevé tout en résistant au ternissement. Le chrome poli reflète presque 70% du spectre visible, avec près de 90% de la lumière infrarouge réfléchie.

title: cobalt
text: Le cobalt est un élément chimique de symbole Co et de numéro atomique 27. Comme le nickel, le cobalt n'est trouvé dans la croûte terrestre que sous forme chimiquement combinée, sauf pour de petits dépôts trouvés dans les alliages de fer météorique naturel. L'élément libre, produit par fusion réductrice, est un métal dur, lustré, gris argenté. Le cobalt a été découvert par le chimiste suédois Georg Brandt en 1735, et son nom vient du mot allemand "Kobold" ou "lutin" en raison de ses propriétés électrochimiques.

title: copernicium
text: Le copernicium est un élément chimique synthétique de symbole Cn et de numéro atomique 112. Son isotope connu le plus stable, le copernicium-285, a une demi-vie de 28 secondes. Le copernicium a été synthétisé pour la première fois en 1996 par l'équipe de Sigurd Hofmann au Gesellschaft für Schwerionenforschung (GSI) à Darmstadt, en Allemagne. Il porte le nom de l'astronome Nicolaus Copernicus. C'est un élément de transition extrêmement radioactif qui a été produit en bombardant du plomb avec du zinc.

title: copper
text: Le cuivre est un élément chimique de symbole Cu (du latin : cuprum) et de numéro atomique 29. C'est un métal mou, malléable et ductile avec une conductivité thermique et électrique très élevée. Une surface de cuivre fraîchement exposée a une couleur orange rougeâtre. Le cuivre est utilisé comme conducteur de chaleur et d'électricité, comme matériau de construction et comme constituant de divers alliages métalliques, tels que le métal argenté utilisé dans la joaillerie, le cupronickel utilisé pour fabriquer la quincaillerie marine et les pièces de monnaie, et le constantan utilisé dans les jauges de contrainte et les thermocouples pour la mesure de température.

title: curium
text: Le curium est un élément transuranien radioactif de symbole Cm et de numéro atomique 96. Cet élément de la série des actinides a été nommé d'après Marie et Pierre Curie - tous deux connus pour leurs recherches sur la radioactivité. Le curium a été produit pour la première fois en bombardant du plutonium avec des particules alpha (ions hélium) à l'Université de Californie, Berkeley en 1944. C'était le troisième élément transuranien à être découvert même si le quatrième de la série des actinides.

title: darmstadtium
text: Le darmstadtium est un élément chimique de symbole Ds et de numéro atomique 110. C'est un élément synthétique extrêmement radioactif (un élément qui peut être créé en laboratoire mais qui ne se trouve pas dans la nature); l'isotope le plus stable connu, le darmstadtium-281, a une demi-vie d'environ 11 secondes. Le darmstadtium a été produit pour la première fois en 1994 par l'équipe du GSI Helmholtz Centre for Heavy Ion Research (Gesellschaft für Schwerionenforschung) à Darmstadt, en Allemagne.

title: dubnium
text: Le dubnium est un élément chimique de symbole Db et de numéro atomique 105. Le dubnium est synthétique et hautement radioactif; l'isotope le plus stable connu, le dubnium-268, a une demi-vie d'environ 28 heures. Cela limite grandement les expériences chimiques de pointe pouvant être effectuées avec le dubnium. Le dubnium n'apparaît pas dans la nature et ne peut être produit artificiellement. Il porte le nom de Dubna, une ville de Russie, où il a été synthétisé pour la première fois.

title: dysprosium
text: Le dysprosium est un élément chimique de symbole Dy et de numéro atomique 66. C'est un élément de terre rare avec un éclat métallique argenté brillant. Le dysprosium n'est jamais trouvé dans la nature comme élément libre, bien qu'il soit trouvé dans divers minéraux, tels que la xénotime.
